verdict.rationale: Attio documents that lists can be created alongside custom objects to model business processes, each with its own attributes, and that data can be shown as kanbans, which implies separate pipelines per product or motion. Reporting also references stage conversion and pipeline views. However, no evidence explicitly describes multiple pipelines each with its own configurable stage set. Missing for 10: explicit docs on defining distinct stage/status sets per pipeline or list, an example of running parallel pipelines for different products or motions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
